note: The DGRN's civil registry service page lists acts, fees and where to apply, and says nothing of how a record is made or of any system. For the offices denominator: it names posts at Neves, Santana and Trindade for free birth registration under one year, seven posts for certificates (Neves, Guadalupe, Santo Amaro, Angolares, Ribeira Afonso, Santana, Trindade) and the Conservatória do Registo Civil for all other acts, death entries included.
